notes: Grab (motorbike/car) is cheap; the Old Quarter is walkable, so cross among the motorbikes at a steady pace. For Ha Long and Ninh Binh, a tour (hotel pickup included) is the most practical.
October to December is best (20-25°C, dry); January to March is 10-15°C, grey and drizzly, so bring a cardigan; shops are closed during Tet (January-February).
Pho 50-70,000 VND, bun cha 70-80,000, egg coffee 35,000, bia hoi 10-15,000; bring cash in small notes.
The mausoleum is closed Monday and Friday and open in the morning only; cover shoulders and knees in temples, and keep quiet in the mausoleum.
Access to Train Street varies; cafe owners will tell you the times, and keep away from the tracks.
Haggle 30-50% at markets; use Grab for taxis, as street taxi meters can be rigged.

stops.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
stops.tips: Tai chi and aerobics in the morning; The Huc Bridge and Ngoc Son Temple (30,000 VND), Turtle Tower.

stops.name: Pho Gia Truyen Bat Dan
stops.tips: Hanoi's legendary pho bo, open since 1966; pay in the queue and carry your bowl to a table.

stops.name: Hanoi Old Quarter 36 Sokak
stops.tips: Guild streets (Hang Ma for paper, Hang Bac for silver); the old house at 87 Ma May (10,000 VND).

stops.name: Dong Xuan Market
stops.tips: The Old Quarter's wholesale market, with street food behind it.

stops.name: Bun Cha Huong Lien
stops.tips: The bun cha Obama and Bourdain ate: grilled pork patties with noodles, on Le Van Huu.

backups.name: Bun Cha Ta Hanoi
backups.tips: Bun cha in the Old Quarter; an alternative to Huong Lien.

backups.name: Bach Ma Temple
backups.tips: Hanoi's oldest temple, inside the Old Quarter.

days.theme: Ho Chi Minh complex and Temple of Literature

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
stops.tips: The embalmed body of Uncle Ho; open 08:00-11:00 in the morning, closed Monday and Friday, no shorts, silent queue.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Stilt House & One Pillar Pagoda
stops.tips: A wooden stilt house and the single-pillar pagoda, right next to the mausoleum.

stops.name: Temple of Literature
stops.tips: A Confucian temple from 1070 and Vietnam's first university; stelae resting on turtles.

stops.name: KOTO Van Mieu
stops.tips: A social enterprise restaurant that trains street children; opposite the temple.

stops.name: Hoa Lo Prison
stops.tips: The "Hanoi Hilton": a French guillotine and the cells of American pilots, air-conditioned.

backups.name: Cha Ca Thang Long
backups.tips: Turmeric fish fried in a pan (cha ca), a Hanoi speciality.

backups.name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
backups.tips: 54 ethnic groups, with tribal houses in the garden; an alternative to the prison.

days.theme: Train Street, French Quarter and egg coffee

stops.name: Hanoi Train Street
stops.tips: Cafes along Train Street (entry with a cafe purchase); ask the cafe for train times, as access is sometimes closed.

stops.name: St. Joseph's Cathedral
stops.tips: A neo-Gothic cathedral with cafes around it.

stops.name: Cafe Giang
stops.tips: The inventor of egg coffee (ca phe trung), since 1946; on Nguyen Huu Huan.

stops.name: Hanoi Opera House & French Quarter
stops.tips: Colonial boulevards; the Metropole hotel and the opera house facade.

stops.name: Quan An Ngon Phan Boi Chau
stops.tips: Street food stalls gathered under one roof in a garden; try everything.

backups.name: Cafe Dinh
backups.tips: Giang's sister's hidden cafe with a lake view; egg coffee.

backups.name: National Museum of Vietnamese History
backups.tips: History in a colonial building, next to the opera house.

stops.name: Ha Long Bay Boat Tour
stops.tips: 2.5 hours from Hanoi (by expressway); a day tour (~1,200,000 VND, lunch included) or a 1-night cruise (~2-3 million), among 1,600 limestone islands.

stops.name: Ha Long Seafood Lunch on Board
stops.tips: Included in the tour; prawns and squid.

stops.name: Sung Sot Cave
stops.tips: The Surprise Cave, with stalactites; included in the tour.

stops.name: Ti Top Island
stops.tips: A beach, and 400 steps up to a view over the bay; kayaking is optional.

backups.name: Lan Ha Bay Tour
backups.tips: A quieter neighbouring bay (Cat Ba); an alternative to Ha Long.

stops.name: Trang An Boat Tour
stops.tips: 2 hours from Hanoi; a 3-hour river tour by rowed sampan through caves, the Ha Long of the land, UNESCO-listed.

stops.name: Bai Dinh Pagoda
stops.tips: Southeast Asia's largest pagoda complex, with 500 arhat statues.

stops.name: Ninh Binh Goat Meat Restaurant
stops.tips: Ninh Binh's specialities: de nui (goat) and com chay (crispy rice).

stops.name: Hang Mua Viewpoint
stops.tips: 500 steps up the dragon hill; views over the Tam Coc rice fields (yellow in May-June).

backups.name: Tam Coc Boat Tour
backups.tips: 2 hours among rice fields; an alternative to Trang An.

backups.name: Trang An Restaurant Ninh Binh
backups.tips: A restaurant by the Trang An dock; fish instead of goat.

stops.name: Tran Quoc Pagoda
stops.tips: A 6th-century pagoda on West Lake; best in morning light.

stops.name: West Lake Walk Quang Ba
stops.tips: The lake's east shore; flower market in the morning, cafes.

stops.name: Bat Trang Ceramic Village
stops.tips: 13 km from Hanoi; a 700-year-old pottery village where you can make your own bowl in a workshop (50,000 VND).

stops.name: Bat Trang Village Restaurant
stops.tips: Pho and banh cuon in the village.

stops.name: Long Bien Bridge
stops.tips: Eiffel's iron bridge; trains and motorbikes at sunset, banana groves below.

backups.name: Banh Cuon Gia Truyen Thanh Tri
backups.tips: Steamed rice rolls, a breakfast classic.

backups.name: Lotte Observation Deck
backups.tips: On the 65th floor; a view instead of the bridge.

stops.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
stops.tips: Water puppet show (if there is a morning session; evening at 17:00); Hoan Kiem.

stops.name: Hang Gai Silk Shops
stops.tips: The silk street; good for souvenirs.

stops.name: Banh Mi 25
stops.tips: Hanoi's famous banh mi, on Hang Ca.

stops.name: Ta Hien Bia Hoi Corner
stops.tips: A corner for fresh draught beer; quiet at midday, a farewell toast.

stops.name: Noi Bai Airport Bus 86
stops.tips: 45 minutes from the Old Quarter on bus 86; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural
backups.tips: A 4 km ceramic wall; an alternative to the silk shops.
